006package dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDocumentNodeItem;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
010import dev.metaschema.core.model.IMetaschemaModule;
011import dev.metaschema.databind.model.metaschema.binding.METASCHEMA;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013
014/**
015 * Represents a Metaschema module loaded via data binding.
016 * <p>
017 * This interface provides access to the bound representation of a Metaschema
018 * module, including its definitions and constraints.
019 */
020public interface IBindingMetaschemaModule
021    extends IMetaschemaModule<IBindingMetaschemaModule> {
022
023  /**
024   * Get the underlying module data as a bound object.
025   *
026   * @return the bound class
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  METASCHEMA getBinding();
030
031  /**
032   * Get the underling bound objects as a {@link IDocumentNodeItem}.
033   *
034   * @return the document node item
035   */
036  @NonNull
037  IDocumentNodeItem getSourceNodeItem();
038
039  /**
040   * Get a node item that can be used to query the module's model.
041   *
042   * @return the module node item
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  IModuleNodeItem getModuleNodeItem();
046}
